profile.summary:
Asker of the "why"
Bearer and keeper of the "why"

Character > Skills
!skills == !value
Tact > Politics
Integrity > Status Quo

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Configurating the configurators with configurating configureres.
- Built out several distributed clusters that make up the Nasdaq Options Market 2.0, Nasdaq BX Options Market, Nasdaq Futures.
- Wrote the software to configure the configuration systems the thousands of configs that need to be built.
- Wrote operational tools used for day-to-day operational processes.
- Automation (Chef/Perl/Bash/Ruby)

If there's a better mouse trap, I'm the one who's looking for a way to get it working for where ever I am at.

positions.title: Network/Systems Engineer
positions.description:
-Rearchitected mail system for high availability using LVS and optimized current installation of Postfix, Amavis, 
Spamassassin processing 5 million+ connections per day 
-Migrated MTAs from recently acquired ISP by writing perl scripts to parse and import user/configuration data 
-Evaluated moving mail system to Dspam for faster mail scanning and accurate spam detection 
-Tuned MySQL databases for webhosting and busy greylisting environment 
-Assessed current architecture and created consolidation strategy for virtualizing hosts using Xen 
-Setup and managed OpenVPN for remote access to intranet 
-Integrated Linux backup and mail servers to use EMC Clarion over Fibre Channel SAN

positions.title: Network Specialist
positions.description:
-Configured and troubleshooted Nortel 470, 5000 and 8600 series switches and routers on 24k host network 
-Proposed and used open source tools Cacti, SNMP to monitor network usage on switching/routing 
equipment 
-Created a Log Viewer using PHP/MySQL to parse 7 million hits/day on AIX proxies for management to 
pinpoint bandwidth overuse by departments 
-Entrusted with setup of internet facing Windows 2003 DNS environment 
-Acted as final support for internal and external networking problems 
-Provided guidance and mentoring to peers 
-Created a test bed of load balanced Linux proxies using LVS, Squid, Shorewall to replace aging AIX 
environment 
-Trained on Crossbeam systems for Checkpoint Firewall

positions.title: Assistant IT Administrator
positions.description:
-Architected lab deployment strategy in mixed Active Directory, Macintosh environment for 5 labs by meshing 
together Active Directory, Netboot, Radmind, Multicasting, Shell Scripting and Open Directory to automate 
software deployments according to pushed policies 
-Created and managed internal webhosting environment consisting of PHP, MySQL and Apache 
-Assessed and translated user's needs from daily observations into technical solutions immediately available to 
students 
-Assisted with RFI procurement of SAN/NAS storage solutions 
-Familiar with integrating BlueArc NAS, Isilon NAS, Rorke FC Array into Active Directory environments

honors.title: Gold CEO Award
honors.description: The successful launch of Virtual Service Desk Phase 1.

honors.title: Gold CEO Award
honors.description: The successful buildout of the Nasdaq OMX BX Options Trading System
